feeds.title: Cochrane Oral Health
feeds.description: Cochrane Oral Health is part of Cochrane, the worldwide network of researchers in evidence synthesis. We prepare and maintain systematic reviews of clinical trials in oral health. It includes the prevention and treatment of oral, dental and craniofacial disorders and diseases.
